name: คลินิกทันตกรรมปุณณกัณฑ์ทันตแพทย์ หาดใหญ่ Poonnakan Dental Clinic @ Hatyai Thailand

summary_en: Poonnakan Dental Clinic is located in Hatyai and specializes in general dental services. The clinic holds a 4.8-star rating based on 4 reviews and maintains a trust score of 55.2.
